description: This file defines the SugarLogger class, which implements a logging system for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM application. It manages log file creation, writing log entries with timestamps, log rotation based on size, and supports configuration for log file naming and formatting.

classes.name: SugarLogger
classes.description: A logger class implementing the LoggerTemplate interface, providing functionalities for logging messages with timestamp, log rotation, and configuration-based setup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes logger configuration from SugarConfig and prepares the log file.

methods.name: getLogFileNameWithPath
methods.description: Returns the full path of the current log file.

methods.name: getLogFileName
methods.description: Returns the log file path relative to current directory.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, including optional backtrace information.

methods.name: rollLog
methods.description: Performs log rotation if the file exceeds specified size.

methods.name: _doInitialization
methods.description: Handles setup such as filename suffixes based on configuration.

methods.name: _fileCanBeCreatedAndWrittenTo
methods.description: Checks if the log file can be written to or creates it if necessary.

methods.name: getTraceString
methods.description: Generates a backtrace string for debugging purposes.

methods.name: convertStrftimeToIntl
methods.description: Converts strftime format strings to IntlDateFormatter compatible format strings.

methods.name: setDateFormatter
methods.description: Initializes the date formatter used for timestamping logs.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes open file handles when the logger object is destroyed.
